import view

def test_basic():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    assert v.get_loading() == False
    # finish with same id should succeed
    rows1 = [1,2]
    assert v.finish(id1, rows1) == True
    assert v.copy_accepted_rows() == rows1
    # begin again
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    # finish with old id should fail
    assert v.finish(id1, [3,4]) == False
    # finish with new id should succeed
    rows2 = [5,6]
    assert v.finish(id2, rows2) == True
    assert v.copy_accepted_rows() == rows2
    # begin again without finish
    id3 = v.begin('q3')
    assert v.finish(id2, [7,8]) == False
    # finish with id3 should succeed
    assert v.finish(id3, [9,10]) == True
    assert v.copy_accepted_rows() == [9,10]

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = view.View()
    # notes dict exists
    v.notes['job1'] = 'note1'
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    # notes should stay
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'
    rows1 = [1]
    assert v.finish(id1, rows1) == True
    # notes still there
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'
    # new notes added after begin
    v.notes['job2'] = 'note2'
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    rows2 = [2]
    assert v.finish(id2, rows2) == True
    # both notes should exist
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'
    assert v.notes['job2'] == 'note2'

def test_loading_cleared():
    v = view.View()
    # initially loading False
    assert v.get_loading() == False
    # begin clears loading (already False)
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    # after begin, loading False
    assert v.get_loading() == False
    # finish sets rows
    rows1 = [1]
    assert v.finish(id1, rows1) == True
    # begin again should clear loading (already False)
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    assert v.get_loading() == False

def test_duplicate_finish_fails():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    # finish same id twice
    rows1 = [1]
    assert v.finish(id1, rows1) == True
    # second finish with same id should fail
    assert v.finish(id1, [2]) == False

def test_seq_monotonic():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    id3 = v.begin('q3')
    # ids should increase
    assert id1 < id2 < id3

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_basic()
    test_notes_preserved()
    test_loading_cleared()
    test_duplicate_finish_fails()
    test_seq_monotonic()
    print('All tests passed')
